timeline.summary: Nagdevi Trading & Investment Co. Ltd, on behalf of its promoter group (including Oswal Woollen Mills, Vanaik Investors, and 11 promoters like Jawahar Lal Oswal), declared no encumbrance on Nahar Industrial Enterprises shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).
Nahar Industrial reported a fire incident at its Lalru raw cotton godown with no casualties, insured losses, and unaffected operations.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹339.47 Cr (-13.0% YoY), net profit ₹24.97 Cr (+54.3% YoY).
